title: mentha × schultziana var. carinthiaca
intro: Mentha × schultziana var. carinthiaca, commonly known as Carinthian mint or berg mint, is a variant of the peppermint plant, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include alleviating digestive issues, relieving nausea and headaches, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha × schultziana var. carinthiaca are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include menthol, menthone, limonene, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
